name: RightFacts – Verified Business Facts for AI Answers
author: magnawebworks

sections.description:
Customers now ask AI assistants “Are they open Sunday?” or “What’s their return policy?” before they call or visit. When the answer is wrong, the business usually never finds out.

RightFacts is built around one question: does AI get your business right? It keeps a single record of facts that you, the owner, have checked and dated. It grades what AI assistants actually say against that record. When an answer is wrong, it publishes a dated correction in the places AI tools and search engines read.

1. Check what AI says (free, no API keys)

  • RightFacts writes 8 to 10 plain questions from your own facts, such as “What are your hours on Saturday?” or “How much is the Starter package?”. You can add your own questions, with words a right answer must include and words that make it wrong.
  • Ask the questions in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini/Google, Claude or any other assistant, then paste the answers in. Each answer is graded correct, partly right, wrong, didn’t know or didn’t say.
  • The grader understands what businesses get asked about. It compares phone numbers digit by digit and reads hours written as prose (“9 a.m. to 5 p.m. weekdays”, “closed weekends”). It also checks prices to within 1%, numbers written as words, cities and ZIP codes, and your web address.
  • Your first check is your baseline. Every later check shows whether the answers got better or worse.

2. Correct what AI gets wrong

  • Next to every wrong answer is a Publish a correction link. It fills in what the assistant said and what is actually true, ready for you to edit and save.
  • Corrections are published, each with its date, on your Business Facts page, in llms.txt and llms-full.txt, in the JSON feed, and as schema.org CorrectionComment entries on the facts page.

3. Owner-verified facts, with a date

  • One facts screen holds your name, business type, hours, address (you can hide the street), phone, email, services and prices, shipping, return and payment policies, FAQs and official profiles. RightFacts prefills it from your site, your SEO plugin’s business settings, WooCommerce and your Contact, Shipping and Returns pages. Nothing is published until you check it and save.
  • When you tick “I checked these facts today”, RightFacts records a verification date. That date appears on the facts page, in llms.txt, in the JSON feed and as lastReviewed in the schema. An edit nobody checked never moves the date forward.
  • The dashboard reminds you to re-check your facts after 180 days. Prices and hours change, and stale facts are how AI answers go wrong.

4. Publish the facts everywhere AI tools look

One record, several outputs, all kept in sync:

  • Business Facts page (optional, one switch): a clean public page that people and AI tools can cite. Turning it off sets it to draft. It is never deleted.
  • Schema.org JSON-LD: LocalBusiness (or Organization) with hours, address, phone, prices and profiles, FAQPage where the FAQs are visible, and an AboutPage with the verification date and corrections. With Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO active, RightFacts adds your facts to their schema instead of printing a second, conflicting copy.
  • JSON feed at /wp-json/rightfacts/v1/facts: the same public facts, read-only, for apps and AI tools.
  • /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt in the llmstxt.org format, built from your verified facts plus your key pages and WooCommerce best sellers. If your SEO plugin or another plugin already serves llms.txt, RightFacts stands back by default.

Private by design

The free plugin makes no outside connections. It never contacts AI services; in the free version you do the asking and paste the answers in. It only publishes the facts you choose, on your own site.

RightFacts Pro (optional, separate plugin)

RightFacts Pro is an optional, separate add-on from Magna WebWorks. It asks the assistants for you through their official APIs on a schedule, using your own API keys. It also emails you when an answer turns wrong and builds a before-and-after report. Everything described above is free, fully working and stays free. This plugin has no locked features, trial limits or license checks.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate RightFacts.
  2. Go to RightFacts → Business facts. Check what was prefilled, fix anything wrong, tick “I checked these facts today” and save.
  3. Optional: turn on the Business Facts page under AI files & schema.
  4. Open Answer check, ask the questions in your favorite assistant and paste the answers in. That is your baseline.
  5. For each wrong answer, click Publish a correction, edit the wording and save.
sections.faq:
How is this different from an llms.txt generator?

llms.txt is one of five outputs. RightFacts starts from a record of facts you have verified and dated. It grades what AI assistants actually say against that record and publishes dated corrections when they are wrong. The same facts also go out as a public facts page, schema.org data and a JSON feed. If you already have an llms.txt plugin, keep it: RightFacts stands back from llms.txt automatically and still does everything else.

Does this guarantee ChatGPT will say the right thing?

No one can promise that. AI assistants decide what to say. RightFacts makes your correct facts easy to find in the places they look, and it measures whether the answers improve, so you can see the result instead of guessing.

What does “verified” mean here?

It means you, the site owner, ticked “I checked these facts today” on that date. It is not a third-party certification, and RightFacts never describes it as one. Public outputs say “Verified by the business on [date]”.

I already use Yoast SEO / Rank Math / All in One SEO. Will this conflict?

No. RightFacts detects them, adds your business facts to the structured data they already print and leaves llms.txt to them if they serve one. You can change both choices on the AI files & schema tab.

Does the free plugin send my data anywhere?

No. The free plugin makes no outside connections. The JSON feed and llms.txt only publish facts that are already public on your site, and the street address is left out if you hide it.

Can I turn off the JSON feed or llms.txt?

Yes. Each output has its own switch on the AI files & schema tab.

What happens when I uninstall?

Your facts and check history are kept unless you tick “Delete RightFacts data when the plugin is deleted” on the AI files & schema tab. The Business Facts page is never deleted.
sections.changelog:
0.1.2

  • New: Corrections. Publish what AI or other sites get wrong next to the correct fact, each with its date, on the facts page, in llms.txt, in the JSON feed and as schema.org CorrectionComment entries. Wrong answers in the answer check have a “Publish a correction” link.
  • New: Verification date. “I checked these facts today” records when you last verified your facts. The date is shown publicly and as lastReviewed in the facts page schema, with a reminder after 180 days.
  • New: Read-only JSON feed of your public facts at /wp-json/rightfacts/v1/facts (can be turned off).
  • New: AboutPage schema on the Business Facts page linking the page to your business.
  • Changed: the facts page and admin styles and scripts are now loaded with the WordPress enqueue functions instead of inline tags.
  • Changed: plugin name and description now lead with checking and correcting AI answers.

0.1.1

  • Fixed: table cells in page text no longer run together in llms.txt and llms-full.txt.
  • Fixed: dates in llms.txt and llms-full.txt use your site’s time zone.
  • RightFacts now has its own admin menu item.

0.1.0

  • First release.
